answer: Creating N sybils costs N stakes plus N burned deposits, while honest agents recover their stake and earn epoch rewards. Each agent must stake a ferrous token bound to a hardware quill that signs every epoch submission, and registration burns a small onyx deposit. Attackers must repeatedly pay real, non-recoverable value per identity, making mass fake accounts economically irrational as the deposit scales with network size. In practice, Agent0009 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
